brief.headline: Close the ₹82,500 annual price gap on measuring cups and shift to 30-day payment to free up ₹10.19 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Ask Mars to match Premier Plastic's ₹0.35/NOS on the measuring-cup SKU
priceAsk.basis: Premier Plastic already sells us the same measuring cup (MESU. CUP 30MM TRANS.PP 2.5/5/10ML) at ₹0.35/NOS; Mars is 8.6% higher; the market for similar PP caps sits at ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, with headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volumes — so ₹0.35/NOS for a measuring cup is market-fair and we're already paying it elsewhere

paymentTermAsk.summary: Shift from 45 days after receipt to 30 days — faster cash for them
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹10.19 L for us; further 15-day cut (to 15 days total) would free another ₹5.10 L

brief.financialLeverage: Mars publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit or cash position. Our ₹1.24 Cr annual spend is material but not massive. Because we don't know how tight they are, the smart play is to use our internal benchmark (Premier at ₹0.35) and the threat of a second source rather than a hard squeeze. We have five strong alternates — including India's largest rigid-plastic converter, Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100) and listed Mold-Tek (₹946.50 Cr, score 73/100) — so Mars knows we can move volume if they won't match the market.

evidence.point: Premier Plastic sells us the identical measuring-cup SKU 8.6% cheaper
Market data shows PP caps trade at ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, with volume discounts down to ₹0.65–0.80
evidence.figure: Market ask: ₹0.55–1.20/pc band, ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume

evidence.point: Moving to 30-day payment releases over ₹10 lakh of our cash
evidence.figure: ₹10.19 L freed if we go from 45 to 30 days

evidence.point: We have a proven, much larger alternate ready to qualify
evidence.figure: Manjushree Technopack ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100 — India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100); makes pharma bottles, caps and preforms — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health score 73/100); strong and profitable; supplies bottles and closures to pharma

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — manufacturer of rigid plastics, pan-India presence, medium confidence

risks: Mars has no public financials — we can't tell if a price cut or tighter terms will strain them; watch for pushback that signals cash trouble
Our ₹1.24 Cr spend may not be big enough to force their hand alone; lean on the alternate pipeline (Manjushree, Mold-Tek) to show we're serious about moving share
Premier's ₹0.35 price sets our ceiling — if Mars won't match it, we risk overpaying ₹82,500 annually on this one SKU for no reason
The market backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are not yet qualified — don't treat them as approved sources until we verify capability and price
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying Premier ₹0.35 per piece for the same measuring cup you charge us ₹0.38 for — let's talk about how you can match that price and move to 30-day payment so we both get faster cash flow.
